content.motto: Honest goods from another era, found for this one.

lead.headline: A Danish Walnut Credenza Surfaces from an Estate in the Hudson Valley
lead.subhead: Six drawers, tapered legs, original pulls intact. A piece that traveled far to sit quietly in the right room.

photo.prompt: A low Danish walnut credenza with tapered legs and six original brass pulls, photographed in soft side-light against a plain white wall, 1960s mid-century modern furniture, clean editorial still life
photo.alt: Danish walnut credenza with original brass pulls
photo.caption: Estate find, Hudson Valley. Circa 1962. Condition: excellent throughout.

lead.bodyDropCap: The credenza arrived on a Tuesday, wrapped in moving blankets and smelling faintly of cedar. It came out of an estate in Rhinebeck, part of a living room that had not changed since 1968. The walnut veneer is tight, the brass pulls show only the lightest patina, and all six drawers slide without resistance.
lead.bodyContinuation: Pieces like this move quickly. The proportions are right for a dining room or a long hallway. The maker's mark on the underside reads Brdr. Furbo, a small Danish workshop that operated through the early seventies. This one is priced to sell, not to sit.

stories.headline: Three Sales Scheduled for Late July
stories.body: Three estate sales in Columbia County are on the calendar for the last two weeks of July. Two are from families downsizing after decades in the same house. Expect teak, walnut, and the occasional piece of Scandinavian pottery. First right of refusal goes to newsletter subscribers.

stories.headline: What Patina Means Here and What It Does Not
stories.body: Every listing uses the word patina honestly. It means age-appropriate wear that does not affect function or structure. It does not mean damaged, repaired without disclosure, or refinished without notice. If a piece has been touched up, that is in the listing. Always.

stories.headline: White Glove Freight Now Available on Select Pieces
stories.body: Larger furniture, including case goods and tables, can now ship via white glove freight to most of the continental United States. The carrier wraps, pads, and delivers to room of choice. Rates are quoted per piece. Ask at checkout or send a message before buying.

items.headline: Knoll-Style Tulip Side Table
items.body: White fiberglass top, cast iron pedestal base, 20-inch diameter. No chips. Original production, not a reproduction.

items.headline: Pair of Teak Bookends
items.body: Heavy, solid teak. No markings. Good original condition with minor surface wear consistent with age.

items.headline: Arc Floor Lamp, Brushed Steel
items.body: Seven-foot arc, weighted marble base, white drum shade. All wiring tested and intact. Works perfectly.

items.headline: Rosewood Veneered Box
items.body: Small decorative box with hinged lid, likely Danish, 1960s. Interior lined with aged felt. No damage.

items.headline: Wicker and Cane Magazine Rack
items.body: Mid-century form, tight weave, no breaks. Sits level. Patina on frame consistent with age.

items.headline: Milo Baughman–Style Sling Chair
items.body: Chrome frame, black leather sling seat, excellent structural condition. Leather shows light surface crease.

founderNote.title: From the Picker
paragraphs: I started doing this because I kept finding pieces too good to leave behind and had nowhere to put them. The apartment filled up fast. The shop followed.

Everything here I have handled myself. I drive to the sales, I carry the furniture, and I take the photographs on the same folding table in my garage. There is no warehouse. There is no assistant. When you send a message, I write back.
The things I bring in are the things I would keep if I had more room. That is the only filter I use. It is not complicated, but it keeps the inventory honest.

colophon.description: The Mid Mod Gazette is published by Mid Mod and More, a small vintage shop dealing in mid-century modern furniture and objects sourced from estates, flea markets, and private collections across the Northeast.
